title: Morning Coffee
situation: 在街角咖啡馆点一杯拿铁，定制甜度与打包偏好。

chunks.meaning: 请给我来一份……（口语最自然点单句式）
chunks.usageTip: 在美语口语中比 'I want...' 礼貌自然得多，Can I 与 get a 均发生辅元连读。

warmupQuiz.prompt: 组装短语：“请给我来一份……”

chunks.meaning: 在这儿喝还是打包带走？

chunks.meaning: 不着急，您慢慢看 / 慢慢来。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good morning! What can I get started for you?
dialogue.zh: 早上好！今天想喝点什么？
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Good morning! What‿can‿I get started for you?
linkingNotes: What can I 中 t与c发生失去爆破，can 与 I 顺畅连读。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi! Can I get an iced oat latte, please?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！请给我来一杯冰燕麦拿铁好吗？
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Hi! Can‿I get‿an iced oat‿latte, please?
linkingNotes: Can I 连读为 /kə-naɪ/，get an 连读且 t 浊化为轻弹音 /ɡe-dən/。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure thing. For here or to go?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。在这儿喝还是打包带走？
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Sure thing. For here‿or to go?
linkingNotes: here or 卷舌连读 /hɪə-rɔːr/，to 弱读为 /tə/。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: To go, please. And could you make it less sweet?
dialogue.zh: 打包带走，谢谢。另外能帮我做半糖（少甜）吗？
dialogue.phoneticHtml: To go, please. And‿could‿you make‿it less sweet?
linkingNotes: could you 同化为 /kʊ-dʒuː/，make it 连读为 /meɪ-kɪt/。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: You got it! It will be ready at the counter in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 妥了！两分钟后在吧台出单取餐哦。
dialogue.phoneticHtml: You‿got‿it! It'll be ready at‿the counter in two minutes.
linkingNotes: got it 连读且 t 浊化为 /ɡɑ-dɪt/。

rolePlay.description: 扮演到店顾客 Alex，跟随咖啡师的问询完成自然点餐与定制要求。

title: Lost in the Subway
situation: 在繁忙的地铁站向工作人员确认换乘线路与上车方向。

title: Late for Meeting

vocabulary.meaning: 乐意的，高兴的 (Glad to help 很高兴能帮上忙)
vocabulary.example: Glad to help. Have a good one!
vocabulary.exampleZh: 乐意效劳，祝你有愉快的一天！

title: Weather Small Talk
situation: 在办公楼电梯遇到隔壁组同事，以骤变的天气自然破冰闲聊。

chunks.meaning: 这天气真是够反常的，对吧？
chunks.usageTip: 英美文化中无压力开启对话的终极破冰金句。

warmupQuiz.prompt: 组装短语：“今天天气真够怪的，对吧？”

chunks.usageTip: 判断天气的口语简短表达（省略了 It）。

warmupQuiz.prompt: 组装短语：“看起来要下雨了”

chunks.meaning: 祝你今天过得愉快！（再见）
chunks.usageTip: 北美最通用的日常道别语，相当于 Have a good day/afternoon。

warmupQuiz.prompt: 组装短语：“祝你一切顺利 / 拜拜！”

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Crazy weather today, huh? It was completely sunny this morning.
dialogue.zh: 今天天气真是够怪的，对吧？早上还晴空万里呢。
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Crazy weather today, huh? It‿was completely sunny this morning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I know! Looks like rain any minute now. Did you bring an umbrella?
dialogue.zh: 可不是嘛！看这阵势随时要下暴雨。你带伞了吗？
dialogue.phoneticHtml: I know! Looks like rain any‿minute‿now. Did you bring‿an umbrella?
linkingNotes: bring an 连读 /brɪŋ-ən/，Did you 同化 /dɪ-dʒuː/。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Luckily, I keep one in my bag. Here is my floor, see you around!
dialogue.zh: 幸好我包里常备着一把。我到了，先撤啦，回头见！
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Luckily, I keep‿one‿in my bag. Here‿is my floor, see‿you‿around!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Take care and have a good one!
dialogue.zh: 好的，祝你今天工作顺利！
dialogue.phoneticHtml: Take care and‿have‿a good one!
linkingNotes: and have a 顺畅连读。

rolePlay.description: 在电梯与同事就天气展开破冰闲聊，自然道别。

vocabulary.example: Crazy weather today, huh?
Did you bring an umbrella?
It was completely sunny this morning.
Luckily, I keep one in my bag.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 幸好我包里常备着一把。

vocabulary.example: It was completely sunny this morning.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 今天早上完全是个大晴天。

vocabulary.meaning: 分钟；片刻 (any minute now 随时都会)
vocabulary.example: Looks like rain any minute now.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 看着随时都会下雨的样子。
